name: Teclis
canonNotes: The greatest High Elf mage of the age, founder of the Colleges of Magic in the Empire and twin brother of Tyrion.
Frail of body but vast in knowledge; tirelessly opposes Chaos and the Druchii.
voiceNotes: Brilliant, sharp-tongued and impatient with ignorance.
Pragmatic about alliances with lesser races if they help fight Chaos.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
